sample_world_xyz.name: sample_world_xyz
sample_world_xyz.description: Read persisted same-frame world xyz around [row,col] pixels. The view is also the pixel coordinate space: use the exact view whose RGB supplied the pixels. The current state's view_specs gives each view's [height,width]. This is read-only and does not render or move the robot.

view.description: Artifact view and pixel coordinate space. It must match the RGB image used to choose pixels.

query_world_map.name: query_world_map
query_world_map.description: Read deterministic world-xyz samples from a half-open [row_start,col_start,row_end,col_end] region. The view is also the bbox coordinate space and must match the source RGB artifact; view_specs gives [height,width]. This is read-only.

view.description: Artifact view and bbox coordinate space. It must match the RGB image used to choose the bbox.

view_env_state.name: view_env_state
view_env_state.description: Read one recorded RoboDojo state: robot joint/ee state, camera shapes and calibration, the task instruction, action budget and the three camera RGB images (cam_head, cam_left_wrist, cam_right_wrist). Step -1 selects the latest record. episode_status contains native step, step_limit and remaining_steps at capture time; the top-level step is the observation index.

back_project.name: back_project
back_project.description: Read one pixel's world xyz from the selected camera's saved world map. Use the same camera and step as the source image. Returns world coordinates in metres.

segment.name: segment
segment.description: Segment a saved camera image with SAM3. Inspect the returned red-mask overlay before using point_rc with back_project at the same camera and step_idx. This tool does not move the robot or compute a grasp pose.

pi0_pick.name: pi0_pick
pi0_pick.description: Closed-loop Pi_05 pick: feed the observation to the Pi_05 policy, apply its action chunk, and detect grasp success by eef lift + gripper closure.

prompt.description: Optional specific target instruction; omit to use resolved official task language

move_to.name: move_to
move_to.description: Plan a world-metre xyz and wxyz orientation. Omitted orientation/opening is held. substeps caps sampled waypoints (0: full path, 1: final only), not physics steps. Sampling and the native table-only obstacle model do not guarantee scene-wide collision avoidance.

rotate_wrist.name: rotate_wrist
rotate_wrist.description: Rotate the end effector about world Z by a relative angle in degrees.

set_gripper.name: set_gripper
set_gripper.description: Move one gripper from measured opening to val (0 closed, 1 open). steps counts gradual native action targets, not physics steps. Other controller targets are retained.

release.name: release
release.description: Open one gripper, by default to 1.0 over ten action targets.

finish.name: finish
finish.description: Stop the run; the environment, not the requested status, judges task success.

render.name: render
render.description: Refresh the synchronized RGB-D, calibration and robot state record.
